info.title: Axolotl Origin Statistics API
info.description: Authenticated origin request analytics, 14-day retention, no Cloudflare dependency. See STATS_API.md for measurement semantics and upgrade instructions.

parameters.name: dimensions
parameters.description: Up to eight comma-separated dimensions. Defaults to route,status_code,country,browser,os,device_type,channel,client_version.

200.description: Statistics response. No-store; asynchronous ingestion can lag.

429.description: Rate limit or two concurrent statistics requests already running

503.description: Query timed out or authentication is not configured

start.name: start
start.description: Inclusive RFC3339 start; default end-24h; clamped to 14-day retention.

end.name: end
end.description: Exclusive RFC3339 end; default current time.

interval.name: interval
interval.description: UTC bucket interval; auto targets at most about 240 buckets; at most 2000 buckets.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Top groups: default 20. Request page: default 100.
